note: Fictional. A moose drive in a North Karelian village; two standers fire, one man dies, the bullet is lost. The old stump for post 6 had been taken out in a thinning; the leader walked Pekka to a birch and read the other sectors off last year's card. Each of the four holds a fragment no one else has. Conversations take place 23-29 November 2026.

design.template: two shots on a moose drive; the bullet lost; the old stump gone so the leader used last year's sector card; each of four people holds a private fragment

Esa Kinnunen, 63: stander at post 4; retired forestry worker; lives with his wife Anna in Korvenkyla.

Places: Korvenkyla, a village in North Karelia; the club hut at the edge of the forest; the marsh between posts 4, 5 and 6; the parish hall.

settled.fact: The night before the hunt, Pekka tells Sari: 'Jari wants me by the birch at the clearing tomorrow. The old stump is gone. I don't like it; it's in the open.'

That morning the stump that had marked post 6 was gone after a thinning. Jari walked Pekka to a birch at the edge of the clearing, about thirty metres on from last year's mark, and told him to stand there. He read Esa and Mikko their sectors from last year's card in the hut drawer and did not redraw it. He did not mention the birch to them. His own copy of the card, still in his jacket, has a pencil note from September: '6 to the birch if the stump is gone.'
At midday, at the club hut, Mikko drinks two beers with lunch, against club rules.

At 13:40 the moose crosses between posts 4 and 5. Esa, at post 4, and Mikko, at post 5, both fire. As Esa pulls the trigger he sees a flash of orange in the trees. He later tells the police he saw only the moose. The moose escapes, wounded.

settled.fact: At 13:40 Pekka is hit by one bullet. He is found about fifteen metres from post 6 and dies there.

The bullet passed through Pekka and was never found in the marsh. Both rifles are 6.5×55. The police cannot tell whose shot killed him, and both men are under investigation for possible manslaughter by negligence.
Jari tells the police that the posts were set 'as usual,' reading from last year's sector card.
